entries.title: Milestone celebrations on Facebook
entries.description: The Orbis Facebook page now celebrates when Orbis, a community, or the page itself reaches a new member or follower milestone, with an image to mark the moment.

entries.title: See how many people follow Orbis on Facebook
entries.description: The home page stats and the Find us page now show the Facebook page's follower count, and you can tap it to follow along.

entries.title: Links and downloads work better in the desktop app
entries.description: Links to other sites now open in your usual browser, and when a download finishes, the desktop app shows you the file in its folder.

entries.title: Library status tabs sit below the toolbar
entries.description: In your library and on profiles, the status tabs now come after the search and sort controls, so the page reads more naturally from top to bottom.
